definitions: Reduce (a building or place) to a state of decay, collapse, or disintegration.
Damage (something) so severely that it is spoiled or destroyed.
Cause (a person or their career) to fail financially or socially.
examples: The old castle was left to ruin.
The bad weather ruined our picnic.
pastTenses: ruined (past simple), ruined (present perfect), ruined (past perfect)
